name: FILMZ Mainz
desc: Mainz's festival of German-language cinema: new features, documentaries and shorts from Germany, Austria and Switzerland, often with filmmakers present.
basis: Official festival site

name: IFFMH Film Festival
desc: One of Germany's oldest film festivals, focused on arthouse and auteur cinema from new international directors, screening in Mannheim and Heidelberg.
basis: Festival programme / listings for the 75th edition

name: Jazzdor Strasbourg
desc: Strasbourg's contemporary jazz festival: adventurous European and international artists in venues across the city and the Rhine region.
basis: Local event coverage of the 2026 programme (official site no longer shows festival dates)

name: GLOW Eindhoven
desc: Eindhoven's free light-art festival: a walking route of outdoor installations and projections through the city each evening for a week.
basis: Official GLOW site

name: Museum Nacht Amsterdam
desc: One ticket, one night: dozens of Amsterdam museums stay open until the early hours with DJs, performances, workshops and food. Tickets sell out.
basis: I amsterdam listing (first Saturday of November)

name: Christmas Garden Stuttgart
desc: An after-dark walking trail through the Wilhelma zoo-garden, with illuminated trees, glowing tunnels and large light installations. Light show only, not a market; book a timed slot.
basis: Official site lists the 2026/27 season 18 Nov 2026 – 16 Jan 2027 at Wilhelma.

name: Beaujolais Nouveau
desc: The new Beaujolais vintage is released at midnight on the third Thursday of November, with cellar tastings, torch processions and village parties.
basis: Release date fixed by French decree: 3rd Thursday of November

name: Christmas Garden Koblenz
desc: An after-dark light trail of about 2 km through Ehrenbreitstein fortress above the Rhine, with 20-plus glowing installations and a big projection show on the palace walls.
basis: Official Christmas Garden site: 19 Nov 2026 – 10 Jan 2027

name: Amsterdam Light Festival
desc: Light artworks along Amsterdam's canals and streets through the darkest weeks of winter. Free to walk the route, or see it from a canal boat.
basis: Official festival site

name: Chroma – Amiens Cathedral Light Show (Winter)
desc: Nightly projection that repaints the Gothic west front of Amiens Cathedral in the bright colours its medieval sculptors originally used. Free, starts around 7pm in December.
basis: Amiens tourist office lists the winter run as 27 Nov–27 Dec 2026

name: chocolART Chocolate Festival
desc: Germany's biggest chocolate festival takes over Tübingen's half-timbered old town: chocolatiers from across Europe, tastings, workshops, chocolate sculpture and sweet street food for six days.
basis: Official site lists 01.12.–06.12.2026

name: Fête des Lumières Lyon
desc: Lyon glows for four nights around 8 December: light shows on historic façades and along the rivers, and candles in residents' windows. Free.
basis: Official festival site

name: Fêtes de Saint-Nicolas – Grand Défilé
desc: Lorraine honours its patron saint with a big evening parade of floats and giant figures that finishes in Place Stanislas with a light show and fireworks.
basis: City programme and listings give the Grand Défilé on Sat 5 Dec 2026 with the main weekend 5–6 Dec (festivities run 20 Nov–3 Jan).

name: Habits de Lumière
desc: Épernay's Avenue de Champagne lights up with video mapping on the great Champagne houses, street shows, music, fireworks and plenty of bubbly by the glass.
basis: 26th edition announced by the City of Épernay for 11–13 Dec 2026

name: Bastogne Nuts Weekend
desc: Battle of the Bulge commemoration: WWII vehicle parade, re-enactors in period kit, the McAuliffe 'Nuts!' tribute and a historic perimeter walk around the siege lines.
basis: Held on the second weekend of December each year to mark the 1944 siege; bastogne.be has registrations open for the 82nd anniversary parade but no date shown

name: Kerstbierfestival (Christmas Beer Festival)
desc: Belgium's big winter beer gathering: around 200 seasonal Christmas ales from Belgian and foreign brewers poured in one hall near the Dutch border, served in proper glassware.
basis: Official site: '12 en 13 december 2026: Heuvelhal, Essen'

name: Bitburger 0,0% Silvesterlauf Trier
desc: New Year's Eve road race looping through Trier's old town past the Porta Nigra. Elite runners, fun runs and a crowd lining the cobbles, then Silvester in town.
basis: Race listings give Thu 31 Dec 2026, registration closing 23 Dec 2026.

name: Rotterdam New Year's Eve at the Erasmus Bridge
desc: Tens of thousands line the Maas to count down to midnight as the Erasmus Bridge becomes the launch pad for the country's best-known New Year fireworks show.
basis: Annual midnight fireworks show at the Erasmusbrug, televised nationally; 2026 programme not checked

name: Brussels Motor Show
desc: One of Europe's long-running car shows, back at Heysel with new models, concept cars and test drives. Pair it with an Atomium visit next door.
basis: FEBIAC confirmed the 103rd edition for 8–17 Jan 2027 at Brussels Expo.

name: Brussels Jazz Festival
desc: Ten days of contemporary jazz in Flagey, the Art Deco former radio building in Ixelles. International headliners plus Belgian talent; one pass covers every concert.
basis: Flagey lists the 2027 edition 14–23 Jan 2027, about 25 concerts.

name: National Tulip Day (Nationale Tulpendag)
desc: Dam Square turns into a giant temporary tulip garden in midwinter and visitors may pick a free bunch, the unofficial kick-off of the Dutch tulip season.
basis: Held on the third Saturday of January each year (2026: 17 Jan)

name: VSAN Landschaftstreffen Oberschwaben-Allgäu
desc: Swabian-Alemannic Fasnet starts early. About 43 guilds in carved wooden masks and shaggy costumes take over the spa town for a weekend of parades and noise.
basis: Schwäbische Zeitung reports the VSAN regional fools' meeting in Bad Saulgau 16–17 Jan 2027 with 43 guilds expected.

name: BRAFA Art Fair
desc: Belgium's top fine-art and antiques fair, with about 130 dealers showing everything from ancient artefacts to modern masters. Worth a look even if you're only browsing.
basis: Official BRAFA site: public days 24–31 Jan 2027, Brussels Expo Halls 3 & 4.

name: Max Ophüls Preis Film Festival
desc: Germany's main festival for young German-language filmmakers fills Saarbrücken's cinemas for a week. Premieres, director Q&As and a lively winter festival crowd.
basis: Official festival site headline: 48th edition 25–31 Jan 2027.

name: Gérardmer Fantastic Film Festival
desc: Horror, fantasy and sci-fi film festival in a snowy Vosges lake resort: premieres, competitions, guest directors and a zombie walk through town.
basis: Festival listings give Tue 26–Sun 31 Jan 2027 (34th edition); organiser site not yet showing dates; always late January

name: International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR)
desc: Eleven days of adventurous independent cinema across Rotterdam's theatres, with hundreds of premieres, director Q&As and art installations; one of Europe's biggest public film festivals.
basis: Official site lists 28 Jan – 7 Feb 2027

name: Saint-Vincent Tournante
desc: Burgundy's winemakers honour their patron saint in a different village each year. Banners, a procession and cellars open for tastings with a glass bought at the gate.
basis: Beaune tourism lists the 83rd edition in Volnay 30–31 Jan 2027.

name: Konstanzer Fasnacht
desc: Lake Constance carnival week opens on Schmotziger Dunschtig with the nightshirt-clad Hemdglonker parade, then brings Guggenmusik bands, masked jesters, balls and witch burnings to the old town.
basis: konstanz-info.com lists Fasnacht 2027 as 4–10 Feb

name: Kölner Straßenkarneval
desc: Germany's biggest carnival: costumed crowds pack the Altstadt from Weiberfastnacht. The Rosenmontag parade covers 8.5 km of floats and thrown sweets.
basis: koeln.de: street carnival runs Weiberfastnacht 4 Feb to Veilchendienstag 9 Feb 2027, Rosenmontagszug Mon 8 Feb.

name: Mannheimer Fasnacht
desc: A carnival fairground with rides and food stalls around the Wasserturm and Planken, ending in a street party on Shrove Tuesday.
basis: Calendar-fixed: carnival follows Easter (Rosenmontag 8 Feb 2027); Fête de la Musique is always 21 June.

name: Carnaval de Malmedy (Cwarmê)
desc: Four days of masked mischief in the Ardennes: red-plumed Haguètes snap wooden tongs at onlookers, Monday's satirical street plays, and a straw Haguète burned on Mardi Gras night.
basis: Visit Wallonia lists Sat 6 to Tue 9 Feb 2027 with daily programme

name: Mainzer Fastnacht
desc: One of Germany's big three carnival cities. Costumed crowds, the children's Jugendmaskenzug and the huge Rosenmontag parade wind through the old town.
basis: Calendar-fixed: carnival follows Easter (Rosenmontag 8 Feb 2027); Fête de la Musique is always 21 June.

name: Oeteldonk Carnival
desc: Den Bosch renames itself Oeteldonk and dresses in red-white-yellow and frog motifs for four days of brass bands, peasant smocks, parades and packed cafés; Brabant carnival at its most traditional.
basis: Carnival runs Sat–Tue before Ash Wednesday (10 Feb 2027); Den Bosch follows the standard dates

name: Percée du Vin Jaune
desc: The Jura's famous winter wine party: a barrel of vin jaune aged over six years is ceremonially tapped, then a village fills with tastings, brass bands and crowds.
basis: France.fr lists 6–7 Feb 2027; host village rotates yearly and was not yet confirmed (coordinates = Arbois)

name: Aalst Carnaval
desc: Belgium's most irreverent carnival: a Sunday parade of fiercely satirical floats, Monday's onion and broom throwing, and Tuesday's cross-dressing 'Voil Jeanetten' taking over the town.
basis: Always the Sunday to Tuesday before Ash Wednesday; VRT reports the 97th edition on 7, 8 and 9 Feb 2027 but no official programme yet

name: Carnaval de Binche
desc: UNESCO-listed Walloon carnival. On Mardi Gras the Gilles, in wax masks and tall ostrich-feather hats, stamp through town to drums and throw oranges into the crowd.
basis: Always the three days before Ash Wednesday (10 Feb 2027); listings give 7–9 Feb with the Gilles on Mardi Gras 9 Feb.

name: Elzacher Fasnet (Schuttig)
desc: Over a thousand Schuttig devils in red straw hats with snail shells and carved masks storm this Black Forest valley town, ending with an eerie torchlight procession.
basis: Main Schuttig parades fall on Fasnet Sunday and Tuesday; 2027 = 7 & 9 Feb

name: Frankfurt Fastnacht: Fastnachtszug & Klaa Paris
desc: Frankfurt's big Sunday carnival parade rolls to the Römerberg, then on Tuesday 100,000+ crowd the Heddernheim streets for 'Klaa Paris', Hesse's largest Shrove Tuesday procession.
basis: Fastnachtszug runs Fastnacht Sunday 12:21, Klaa Paris in Heddernheim on Fastnacht Tuesday (15 & 17 Feb 2026); 2027 = 7 & 9 Feb

name: Vastelaovend (Maastricht Carnival)
desc: Maastricht's Limburg carnival is less about big floats and more about the whole city in homemade costumes. Brass 'zaate hermeniekes' bands play through the streets for three days.
basis: Always Sunday to Tuesday before Ash Wednesday (10 Feb 2027), opening at 11:11 on Sunday on the Vrijthof.

name: Villinger Fasnet
desc: One of the purest Swabian-Alemannic Fasnets: the historic Narrozunft parade of carved wooden masks, jingling Narros and Morbili winds through Villingen's walled old town.
basis: 2026 parades ran Fasnet Sunday + Tuesday (15 & 17 Feb); 2027 Fasnet Sunday = 7 Feb

name: Würzburger Faschingszug
desc: Billed as southern Germany's biggest carnival parade: hundreds of floats, marching bands and costumed clubs wind from the Hauger Viertel through Würzburg's baroque old town.
basis: Held every year on Fasching Sunday (15 Feb 2026); 2027 Fasching Sunday = 7 Feb

name: Eupen Rosenmontag Parade
desc: Rhineland-style carnival in German-speaking Belgium: the Rose Monday procession winds through Eupen with floats, marching bands and sweets raining down, Cologne flavour without Cologne crowds.
basis: Ostbelgien carnival agenda lists Rose Monday on 8 Feb 2027

name: Koblenzer Rosenmontagszug
desc: Koblenz's huge carnival parade: floats, bands and costumed groups roll 4 km through the city from 12:11, showering sweets, before the party moves to Münzplatz.
basis: Always held on Rosenmontag (8 Feb 2027); 2026 parade set off at 12:11 from Rheinstraße

name: Rottweiler Narrensprung
desc: Thousands of masked Narren leap and jingle through the Black Gate in Germany's oldest town in Baden-Württemberg. One of the most traditional parades of the Swabian-Alemannic Fasnet.
basis: Held every Fasnetsmontag and Fasnetsdienstag at 8:00 and 14:00 (2026: 16–17 Feb); for 2027 that is 8–9 Feb.

name: Heidelberger Fastnachtsumzug
desc: Among Germany's oldest carnival parades, dating to 1848. Floats and marching clubs roll from Bismarckplatz down Hauptstraße to the Marktplatz.
basis: Calendar-fixed: carnival follows Easter (Rosenmontag 8 Feb 2027); Fête de la Musique is always 21 June.

name: Carnaval de Mulhouse
desc: Alsace's biggest carnival: masked balls and concerts build up to a Sunday international cavalcade of floats, Guggenmusik bands and costumed groups through central Mulhouse.
basis: JDS lists 10–14 Feb 2027 with the grand international cavalcade on Sun 14 Feb

name: Bright Brussels Festival
desc: Four free evenings of light art and projections along a walking route through central Brussels. A good antidote to February, and it drew 420,000 visitors in 2026.
basis: Travel Daily News and BX1 report the 11th edition for 11–14 Feb 2027.

name: Buergbrennen
desc: Villages across the Grand Duchy light huge bonfires, often built around a cross, to drive out winter. Expect mulled wine, pea soup and a village-fete atmosphere.
basis: Held the weekend after Carnival Sunday (2026: 21–22 Feb); with Carnival Sunday on 7 Feb 2027, that falls 13–14 Feb.

name: Salon International de l'Agriculture
desc: France's giant farm show: prize cattle and horses, plus halls of regional food and wine from every corner of France to taste your way through.
basis: Official site: 27 Feb–7 Mar 2027

name: Luxembourg City Film Festival
desc: Eleven days of international premieres, documentaries and VR works across the capital's cinemas, with guest directors, talks and a lively festival hub in the old town.
basis: Official site: 'Du 4 au 14 mars 2027', 17th edition

name: Bal du Rat Mort
desc: Ostend's legendary costume ball, founded by James Ensor's circle in 1898: thousands in elaborate themed fancy dress dancing the night away in the seafront Kursaal casino.
basis: Ostend's carnival ball is traditionally held on the first Saturday of March at the Kursaal; 2027 date not yet on ratmort.be

name: Laetare de Stavelot (Blancs Moussis)
desc: Hundreds of hooded white Blancs Moussis with long red noses parade through the abbey town, pelting crowds with confetti and pig bladders in a 500-year-old mid-Lent rite.
basis: Official site: '522th LAETARE Stavelot March 6-7-8 2027'

name: Gimmeldinger Mandelblütenfest
desc: Pink almond blossom on the Haardt hills opens the Pfalz wine year. Expect wine stands, almond treats and packed village lanes, with shuttle buses from Neustadt station.
basis: Date follows the almond bloom; usually two weekends in mid-March (2026: 13–15 & 20–22 Mar)

name: Heidelberger Frühling
desc: Five weeks of classical music across Heidelberg venues, from orchestras and chamber ensembles to song recitals. The festival marks its 30th anniversary in 2027.
basis: Official festival site lists 13.3.–17.4.2027.

name: TEFAF Maastricht
desc: The world's leading fine art and antiques fair fills the MECC with museum-grade old masters, antiquities, design and jewellery, plus extravagant floral displays; tickets open to the public.
basis: TEFAF press release: 13–18 March 2027 (preview days 11–12 Mar)

name: Vente des Vins des Hospices de Nuits
desc: Burgundy's spring wine-auction weekend at the Château du Clos de Vougeot, with open cellars and tastings around Nuits-Saint-Georges.
basis: Charity auction held every second Sunday of March (8 Mar 2026); 2027 date not yet published

name: Rotterdam Art Week
desc: Contemporary art takes over more than fifty Rotterdam venues, anchored by the Art Rotterdam fair at Ahoy, with open studios, side fairs, gallery nights and tours.
basis: Rotterdam tourist board 2027 highlights page: 17–21 March 2027

name: Keukenhof
desc: The famous spring flower park near Lisse, with millions of tulips, hyacinths and daffodils in landscaped beds. Blooms usually peak around mid-April.
basis: Keukenhof official site: open 18 March – 9 May 2027.

name: Salon des Vignerons Indépendants
desc: Hundreds of independent French winegrowers pour their wines and sell by the case straight from the estate. Good for stocking up across every region.
basis: Official salon calendar lists Paris Champerret 18–21 March 2027.

name: Dippemess (Spring)
desc: A Frankfurt folk fair with medieval roots: rides, a Ferris wheel, fair food and the traditional pottery market at the Ratsweg fairground.
basis: Spring Dippemess opens the Friday nine days before Easter and closes two Sundays after (2025 and 2026 both followed this).

name: Lange Nacht der Museen
desc: Dozens of museums, galleries and cultural spaces stay open late on one ticket, with special tours, performances and DJ sets across the city.
basis: Held on a Saturday in the second half of March (21 Mar 2026); Stuttgart tourism lists 20 Mar 2027 but its text is not yet updated.

name: DGTL Amsterdam
desc: Easter-weekend electronic festival in the former shipyard halls of NDSM, known for big techno and house line-ups and an ambitious zero-waste, circular-festival setup.
basis: Official site: DGTL Amsterdam 2027 at NDSM Docklands, 26–28 March

name: Foire du Trône
desc: France's biggest funfair fills a corner of the Bois de Vincennes each spring with rides, games, sweets and street food. A long Paris tradition.
basis: Usually opens the last Friday of March and runs roughly two months (2025 and 2026 both opened late March, closed ~25 May).

name: Kaasmarkt Alkmaar
desc: A centuries-old cheese market on the Waagplein. Porters in guild uniforms carry wheels on wooden barrows to the weigh house. Friday mornings.
basis: Held every Friday morning from the last Friday of March to the last Friday of September.

name: Paaspop
desc: The Netherlands' big Easter-weekend festival celebrates its 50th edition with rock, pop, Dutch-language acts and dance across tented stages in a Brabant field.
basis: Official site: 26-27-28 maart 2027 (50th edition)

name: Nürnberger Frühlingsfest
desc: Franconia's big spring fair by the Dutzendteich lake: beer tents serving local brews, roller coasters, fireworks and a classic Bavarian Volksfest atmosphere over three Easter-season weeks.
basis: Volksfest Nürnberg dates page lists Frühlingsfest 2027 as 27.03.–18.04.

name: Augsburger Plärrer (Spring)
desc: Swabia's largest folk fair, with beer tents, rides and live music. A more local, relaxed take on the Bavarian Volksfest.
basis: Spring Plärrer traditionally opens on Easter Sunday (28 Mar 2027) and runs about two weeks.

name: Éimaischen
desc: Easter Monday folk market in the oldest streets of the capital, famous for the 'Péckvillercher', hand-made clay bird whistles, plus folk music and local crafts.
basis: Held every Easter Monday in the old town (Marché-aux-Poissons); Easter Monday 2027 = 29 Mar

name: Art Paris
desc: A modern and contemporary art fair with around 170 galleries under the Grand Palais glass roof. Strong on French and European artists.
basis: Official site: 1 to 4 April 2027 at the Grand Palais.

name: Gouda Kaasmarkt
desc: A traditional cheese market in front of Gouda's Gothic town hall, with farmers striking deals by hand-clap, weighing demos and tastings. Thursday mornings.
basis: Held Thursday mornings from early April to late August, usually skipping Ascension Day (6 May 2027).

name: Time Warp
desc: A long-running techno event that pioneered big indoor raves. Several stages and an all-night line-up of international DJs at the Maimarkt halls.
basis: Official site: April 03, 2027 at Maimarkthalle (overnight into Sunday).

name: Royal Greenhouses of Laeken open days
desc: Once a year the King's 19th-century iron-and-glass conservatories open to visitors: domes and galleries crammed with camellias, azaleas, palms and rare plants in full spring flower.
basis: The royal glasshouses open to the public for about three weeks each spring from mid/late April; 2027 dates not yet published

name: Amstel Gold Race
desc: The Netherlands' only cycling classic winds over the steep Limburg hills; ride the amateur route on Saturday, then watch the pros attack the Cauberg on Sunday.
basis: Official site: tourist ride Sat 17 April 2027, one day before the pro races (18 April)

name: Bloemencorso Bollenstreek
desc: Floats covered in hyacinths and tulips travel about 40 km through the bulb region from Noordwijk to Haarlem, watched by huge roadside crowds.
basis: Official programme: Saturday 17 April 2027 flower parade (corso week 14–18 April).

name: Octave & Mäertchen
desc: Luxembourg's great Marian pilgrimage: processions to the cathedral's Consoler of the Afflicted, a closing grand procession through the city, and the little Mäertchen fair by the palace.
basis: Visit Luxembourg lists Octave & Mäertchen 17.04.2027–02.05.2027

name: Stuttgarter Frühlingsfest
desc: Three weeks of beer tents, rides and Swabian food on the Cannstatter Wasen. One of Europe's largest spring fairs and calmer than the autumn Volksfest.
basis: Official site: 87th Frühlingsfest April 17 to May 9, 2027.

name: Green Sauce Festival
desc: Frankfurt's seven-herb green sauce takes centre stage at Roßmarkt, with local restaurants competing for the best version alongside cabaret and music.
basis: Official site: 20 April – 1 May 2027 (evening shows from 24 April, final 1 May).

name: Heidelberger Stückemarkt
desc: A respected new-drama festival with premieres, readings and a playwriting competition. The 2027 guest country is Czechia.
basis: Theater Heidelberg: 23 April to 2 May 2027.

name: Blaue Nacht
desc: Nuremberg's long night of art bathes the medieval old town in blue light, with projections, installations, open museums and performances until the early hours.
basis: City site: 'Am Samstag, 24. April 2027'

name: Mannheimer Maimarkt
desc: A huge regional consumer fair with well over a thousand exhibitors covering home, garden, food, tech and farming, plus animal shows.
basis: Official site: 24 April to 4 May 2027.

name: Mosel Wine Festivals
desc: Riverside villages take turns hosting wine festivals with Riesling stands, music and local food. Something on most weekends from spring into autumn.
basis: Village wine festival season on the Mosel runs from late April through October every year.

name: Nacht der Museen
desc: Dozens of museums in Frankfurt and Offenbach open late into the night with exhibitions, music and talks, linked by shuttle buses on one ticket.
basis: Museumsufer site: next Nacht der Museen on 24 April 2027.

name: Triennale Brugge 2027
desc: Bruges' triennial of contemporary art and architecture places large outdoor installations along canals, squares and hidden courtyards, a free trail through the medieval centre all summer.
basis: Official site: '24.04–05.09.2027', theme 'After Birth: Structures of Togetherness'

name: WeinWanderWochenende
desc: Guided walks through Pfalz vineyards with tastings along the way, led by local wine guides. Many villages take part; book popular routes early.
basis: Nationwide WeinWanderWochenende is held on the last weekend of April each year.

name: Koningsdag
desc: The whole country dresses in orange for the king's birthday. Amsterdam fills with street markets, packed canals and music on every corner. Free.
basis: King's Day is fixed on 27 April (a Tuesday in 2027; it only moves when that date is a Sunday).

name: Liberation Day in Wageningen (Bevrijdingsfestival)
desc: The 'City of Liberation', where the 1945 German surrender was signed, marks Remembrance Day and then celebrates freedom with a veterans' parade and a free music festival.
basis: Fixed national dates (4 May remembrance, 5 May Liberation Day); organiser site counts down to Liberation Day 2027 with programme 4 & 5 May

name: Breda Jazz Festival
desc: Over the Ascension weekend Breda's historic centre fills with free outdoor stages of trad jazz, swing and blues, drawing hundreds of thousands to its squares and terraces.
basis: Official site: 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 mei 2027 (Ascension weekend)

name: Procession of the Holy Blood
desc: UNESCO-listed Ascension Day procession: some 1,700 costumed participants stage biblical scenes and the history of Bruges as the relic of the Holy Blood is carried through town.
basis: Official site: 'Thursday 6 May 2027, start at 14:30 (Dijver)'

name: Brüder Grimm Festspiele
desc: Open-air theatre in the Grimm brothers' birthplace: fairy-tale adaptations, musicals and plays for adults staged under a canopy in the park of Schloss Philippsruhe.
basis: Official site: '7. Mai bis 31. Juli 2027'

name: Festival of the Roman Wine Route
desc: A wine festival in Schweich that opens the outdoor season on the Roman Wine Route, with stands from local estates and the crowning of the wine royalty.
basis: Held Friday to the second Sunday of May (2025: 9–11 May; 2026: 8–10 May).

name: Weingartner Blutritt
desc: Europe's largest equestrian procession: some 2,000 riders in tailcoats and top hats escort the Holy Blood relic through the fields around Weingarten's giant baroque basilica.
basis: Always Blutfreitag, the Friday after Ascension (6 May 2027)

name: ING Night Marathon Luxembourg
desc: Marathon and half-marathon run after dark from Kirchberg through the floodlit capital, with bands, DJs and crowds lining the course long into the night; great even as a spectator.
basis: Official site: 'Marathontag 08. Mai 2027'

name: Kattenstoet (Cat Parade)
desc: Triennial cat-themed pageant: giant cat floats and 2,000 costumed performers fill Ypres, ending with a jester tossing toy cats from the Cloth Hall belfry. Next after 2027 is 2030.
basis: Official site: 'zaterdag 8 en zondag 9 mei 2027... de 47ste Kattenstoet'; parade Sun 3pm

name: Erlanger Bergkirchweih
desc: The 'Berch' is Franconia's cult beer festival: twelve days of drinking under old trees at hillside beer cellars, with rides, brass bands and a famously local crowd.
basis: City of Erlangen: 'see you from May 13 to 24, 2027'

name: FIMU – International University Music Festival
desc: Free festival that fills Belfort's old town with student bands and orchestras from dozens of countries: jazz, classical, rock and world music on outdoor stages.
basis: Held on Pentecost weekend (16 May 2027); festival listing shows 13–16 May 2027, programme not yet released

name: Festival Perspectives
desc: A Franco-German festival of contemporary stage arts: theatre, dance, circus and street shows from both sides of the border, at venues around Saarbrücken.
basis: Official site: 49th edition 13–22 May 2027

name: Schlossgrabenfest
desc: Hesse's biggest free music festival: four days of rock, pop and hip-hop on several stages around Darmstadt's castle moat, drawing hundreds of thousands over Pentecost weekend.
basis: Official site: 'vom 13. bis 16. Mai 2027'

name: Africa Festival Würzburg
desc: Europe's largest festival of African music and culture fills the Main meadows with concerts, a big bazaar, food stalls, dance workshops and films.
basis: Held over Pentecost weekend (22–25 May 2026); 2027 Pentecost = 16 May

name: Jazz in Duketown
desc: Free, volunteer-run jazz festival over Pentecost weekend, with stages on Den Bosch's Markt and old squares covering everything from big band to funk and soul.
basis: Official site: Jazz in Duketown 2027 – 14 t/m 16 mei

name: Kuchen- und Brunnenfest
desc: The salt-boilers' Pentecost festival: costumed dances on the great church steps, historic games, drums and pipes in one of Swabia's most beautiful old towns.
basis: Pentecost weekend Fri–Mon (22–25 May 2026); 2027 Pentecost = 16 May

name: Meistertrunk Show
desc: Rothenburg replays its legend of a mayor who saved the town in 1631 by draining a giant tankard, with costumed parades, camps and music.
basis: Historical festival is held over the Whitsun weekend (Pentecost 16 May 2027).

name: Michelstädter Bienenmarkt
desc: The Odenwald's oldest folk festival takes over Michelstadt's fairytale half-timbered market square and the meadows below, with rides, beer tents, crafts and the queen-bee auction.
basis: Ten-day fair around Pentecost (22–31 May 2026); 2027 Pentecost = 16 May

name: Open Ohr Festival
desc: A Whitsun festival on the Mainz citadel mixing music, theatre, cabaret and debate around a yearly theme. Relaxed, political and family-friendly.
basis: Official site: 53rd OPEN OHR Festival 14–17 May 2027 (Whitsun).

name: Weinmarkt der Ahr (Pfingstweinmarkt)
desc: Over Pentecost, Ahrweiler's walled old town fills with Spätburgunder, sparkling wine and brandy from Ahr estates, plus live music and Friday's crowning of the Ahr wine queen.
basis: Ahrtal tourism save-the-date: 14–17 May 2027 (Pentecost Fri–Mon)

name: Wäldchestag
desc: Frankfurt's unofficial holiday in the city forest, with beer gardens, apple wine, fairground rides and music. Many locals take the Tuesday off.
basis: Runs the Friday before Pentecost to Whit Tuesday; main day is the Tuesday after Whitsun (18 May 2027).

name: Festival Médiéval de Sedan
desc: Jousting, sword fights, fire shows, encampments and a craft market inside one of Europe's largest fortified castles. Around 40,000 visitors over the weekend.
basis: Held each May at the château (16–17 May 2026); 2027 dates not yet announced

name: Nuit Européenne des Musées
desc: Museums across Paris and France open free into the night with special tours, light installations and performances. Expect queues at the big names.
basis: Held on a Saturday in mid-to-late May (3rd Saturday in 2024–25, 23 May in 2026).

name: Wine Taste Enjoy (Moselle open cellars)
desc: Summer kick-off on the Luxembourg Moselle: dozens of wineries along the river open their cellars for tastings of Rieslings, Pinots and Crémants, with shuttle buses between villages.
basis: Luxembourg Moselle winemakers open their cellars over Pentecost weekend; Pentecost 2027 = 16 May. Date 'coming soon' on visitmoselle

name: Marche Sainte-Rolende
desc: One of the UNESCO-listed folk marches of Entre-Sambre-et-Meuse: thousands in Napoleonic-era uniforms escort the saint's shrine on a 35 km tour with fifes, drums and musket volleys.
basis: UNESCO-listed Entre-Sambre-et-Meuse march held every Whit Monday; Whit Monday 2027 = 17 May

name: Echternach Hopping Procession
desc: UNESCO-listed dancing procession in honour of St Willibrord. Thousands of pilgrims hop in rows through the old abbey town to a looping folk tune.
basis: Justarrived listing gives Tue 18 May 2027; held every Whit Tuesday (Pentecost 16 May 2027).

name: Historische Geißbockversteigerung
desc: A centuries-old Pentecost Tuesday custom: Lambrecht hands over a billy goat as medieval rent, and it is auctioned on Deidesheim's town-hall steps amid costumed pageantry.
basis: Deidesheim events page lists 18 May 2027 (Pfingstmarkt 14–18 May)

name: Brussels Jazz Weekend
desc: Free city-wide jazz festival: hundreds of concerts on outdoor stages from the Grand-Place to Place Sainte-Catherine, plus gigs in cafés and clubs across Brussels.
basis: Official site: 'SAVE THE DATE 21, 22 & 23 MAI 2027'

name: Dutch Beer Tasting Festival
desc: Dutch craft brewers pour hundreds of beers inside The Hague's medieval Grote Kerk. The opening event of Dutch Beer Week.
basis: Den Haag city listing (German page) shows Fri 21 and Sat 22 May 2027.

name: Doudou (Ducasse de Mons)
desc: UNESCO-listed Trinity weekend: the golden reliquary carriage is hauled up the cobbled hill, then the Lumeçon battle of Saint George and the dragon unfolds on the Grand-Place.
basis: Official Mons page: 'Rendez-vous le dimanche 23 mai 2027' (Trinity Sunday; festivities run the preceding days)

name: Mosel Wine Week
desc: Wine villages from around Cochem pour Riesling and sparkling wines on the riverside Endertplatz below the castle, with fireworks one evening.
basis: Runs Wednesday to Sunday around Corpus Christi (2023: 7–11 Jun; 2026: 3–7 Jun); Corpus Christi is 27 May 2027.

name: ADAC 24h Nürburgring
desc: More than 100 cars race day and night round the 25 km Nordschleife while huge crowds camp, grill and party in the Eifel forest. It's Germany's great motorsport festival.
basis: Listed for 27–30 May in the ADAC 24h series 2027 calendar; that series was later postponed to 2028, so check the race date nearer the time

name: Tübinger Stocherkahnrennen
desc: Student crews in fancy dress race wooden punts around the Neckar island under the Hölderlin tower; the losing team must drink cod-liver oil. Chaotic, very Tübingen fun.
basis: Traditionally held on Corpus Christi (27 May 2027)

name: Mannheimer Stadtfest
desc: A free city-centre festival with several music stages, food stalls, a children's area and craft market spread across Mannheim's squares.
basis: Official site lists 28.05.–30.05.2027 (page also still shows 2026 programme).

name: Würzburger Weindorf
desc: A wine village of Franconian winemakers' stands on Würzburg's market square, pouring Silvaner from the famous Bocksbeutel flasks alongside regional food and live music.
basis: Ten days late May–early June (29 May–7 Jun 2026)

name: Fêtes Johanniques
desc: Reims relives Joan of Arc bringing Charles VII to be crowned at the cathedral: costumed parade, medieval market, encampments and shows.
basis: Listing confirms May 2027; recent editions on the last weekend of May (30–31 May 2026)

name: Mozartfest Würzburg
desc: Germany's oldest Mozart festival: a month of concerts in the UNESCO-listed Residenz, including candlelit evenings in the Kaisersaal and open-air nights in the court garden.
basis: Official site: '29. Mai bis 27. Juni 2027'

name: Les Nuits de Fourvière
desc: Two months of concerts, theatre, dance and circus under the stars in Lyon's UNESCO-listed Roman amphitheatres above the city.
basis: Runs every summer (28 May–25 Jul 2026); 2027 programme not yet published

name: Holland Festival
desc: The country's flagship international performing-arts festival brings premieres of theatre, opera, dance and music to Amsterdam's stages throughout June.
basis: Runs through most of June each year (2026: 3–28 June); 2027 associate artist announced, dates not yet

name: Saarlouiser Emmes
desc: One of Saarland's biggest street parties fills Vauban's star-shaped fortress town with five open-air stages, pop and schlager acts, food stalls and huge crowds.
basis: Thu–Sat in early June, closing the Saarlouiser Woche (2026: 4–6 Jun)

name: Ludwigsburger Schlossfestspiele
desc: Summer music festival in and around Ludwigsburg's vast baroque palace: orchestral concerts, opera, jazz and open-air events in courtyards and gardens.
basis: Official site: '4. Juni – 1. August 2027'

name: Rock am Ring
desc: Germany's legendary rock festival returns to the Nürburgring, with blink-182, Bring Me The Horizon and Die Toten Hosen headlining three days of stages and camping.
basis: Official site: 4–6 June 2027, campgrounds open 2 June

name: Rock im Park
desc: Rock am Ring's southern twin: three days of rock and metal headliners on the Zeppelinfeld, with campsites around the Dutzendteich lake.

name: BOSS OPEN Stuttgart
desc: An ATP 250 grass-court tournament at TC Weissenhof, a warm-up for Wimbledon that regularly draws top players.
basis: Official BOSS OPEN news: from 5 to 13 June 2027 at TC Weissenhof.

name: Heidelberger Schlossbeleuchtung
desc: The castle ruins glow red as if burning, recalling their 1693 destruction, followed by fireworks over the Neckar and Old Bridge. Three nights a summer.
basis: Shows are held on the first Saturday of June, second Saturday of July and first Saturday of September (2026: 6 Jun, 11 Jul, 5 Sep).

name: Nuit Blanche Paris
desc: An all-night free art trail where installations, performances and projections pop up in streets, churches and public buildings across Paris.
basis: Now held on the first Saturday of June (6 Jun 2026); Paris tourism lists 5 Jun 2027, not yet confirmed by the city.

name: Heidelberger Schlossfestspiele
desc: Open-air opera, plays, family theatre and concerts in the courtyard of Heidelberg Castle on summer evenings.
basis: Theater Heidelberg: 6 June to 1 August 2027.

name: Francofolies Esch/Alzette
desc: Luxembourg's offshoot of the French festival: four days of French-language pop, rap and chanson plus international names on stages in the woodland park above Esch.
basis: Official site title: 'Francofolies - Esch / Alzette - 10 au 13 juin 2027'

name: Best Kept Secret
desc: Indie and alternative music festival on a lakeside beach beside the Beekse Bergen safari park, celebrated for its relaxed crowd and carefully curated line-ups.
basis: Official site: Best Kept Secret 2027, June 11-12-13

name: Hessentag 2027
desc: Hesse's ten-day state festival lands in half-timbered Idstein: big-name concerts (Take That open it), a huge parade, regional food and hundreds of free events.
basis: hessen.de: 'Vom 11. bis zum 20. Juni 2027'

name: Theatrium (Wilhelmstraßenfest)
desc: One of Germany's oldest street festivals turns Wiesbaden's elegant boulevard into a mile of stages, street theatre, food stalls and wine bars.
basis: City site: 48th Theatrium Fri–Sun 11–13 June 2027

name: Mainzer Museumsnacht
desc: One ticket, one long evening: museums, galleries and archives across Mainz, including the Gutenberg Museum, stay open late with special tours, music and shuttle buses.
basis: Held every two years in June (3 Jun 2023, 14 Jun 2025); exact 2027 date not yet published

name: Opernplatzfest
desc: An open-air food festival on the square in front of the Alte Oper, with dishes from Frankfurt restaurants, wine, cocktails and live music.

desc: Europe's biggest metal festival in the Campine heath: five stages, around 200 bands and a 30th-anniversary edition with headliners spanning thrash, hard rock and metalcore.

desc: Lower Franconia's big summer fair on the Main, below Schloss Johannisburg: beer tents, rides, a parade and fireworks over eleven days.

desc: Antwerp's beer weekend gathers dozens of Belgian breweries, from Trappists to tiny craft outfits, under one roof in the grand old Handelsbeurs with hundreds of beers to taste.

name: Pinkpop
desc: The world's longest-running annual pop festival, held in South Limburg just over the German border; the 2027 bill includes blink-182, Mumford & Sons and RAYE.
basis: Official site: 18 • 19 • 20 june 2027

name: Tollwood Summer Festival
desc: A month-long culture festival in Munich's Olympiapark with concerts, theatre, art and an international market. Many events are free.
basis: Runs about four weeks from mid-June to mid-July; listings show 2027 concerts 19 Jun – 17 Jul, official dates not yet confirmed.

name: Varend Corso Westland
desc: Boats dressed in flowers, fruit and vegetables sail a three-day route through Westland, Delft and The Hague. Pick a canal-side spot and watch.
basis: Official site: Friday 18, Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 June 2027.

name: Rheingau Musik Festival
desc: Classical, jazz and crossover concerts in monasteries, palaces and wine estates across the Rheingau, led by the Kloster Eberbach basilica. Pair a concert with a vineyard dinner.
basis: Official site: 40th festival '19. Juni bis zum 4. September 2027'

name: Vlaggetjesdag
desc: Scheveningen harbour celebrates the new herring season with flag-decked boats, a fish market, maritime demos and plenty of fresh Hollandse Nieuwe.

name: Fête de la Musique Strasbourg
desc: Free concerts take over Strasbourg's streets, squares and bars for one evening, from amateur bands to DJs and choirs.
basis: Calendar-fixed: carnival follows Easter (Rosenmontag 8 Feb 2027); Fête de la Musique is always 21 June.

desc: On the eve: a torchlight parade, free street concerts and fireworks over the Pétrusse valley. On the day itself, a military parade and the Te Deum.

name: 24 Hours of Spa
desc: The world's biggest GT endurance race: around 60 GT3 cars battle day and night through Eau Rouge and the Ardennes forest, with paddock access, camping and a fan village.
basis: Official site: '24 - 27 June 2027'

name: Mainzer Johannisnacht

desc: Each night after dusk the gilded 18th-century facades of Place Stanislas come alive with a large-scale projection show. Free and unticketed.

name: Trierer Altstadtfest

desc: Free three-day old-town festival with several music stages, food stalls and crowds spreading between St. Johanner Markt and the Saar riverbank.
basis: Usually the first weekend of July, Fri–Sun (2025: 4–6 Jul; 2026: 3–5 Jul).

desc: Landau's Rathausplatz toasts the new vintage with Federweißer, the cloudy, fizzy young wine, served with onion tart and music at the height of the Pfalz harvest.
basis: Landau tourism highlights: 14–17 Oct 2027

name: Halloween Frankenstein (Burg Königstein)
desc: Germany's best-known Halloween show, moved from Frankenstein Castle into the Königstein ruins. Live actors, scare zones and fog-filled vaults; buy tickets ahead.
basis: Weekends from mid-October to 1 November (2026: 16 Oct–1 Nov); moved from Burg Frankenstein to Burg Königstein in 2024.

name: Hasseltse Jeneverfeesten
desc: Hasselt's jenever weekend. Stalls pour Belgian gin across the old town and the Manneken Pis fountain flows with it. About 145,000 visitors came in 2026.
basis: Traditionally the third weekend of October (2024: 19–20 Oct; 2026: 17–18 Oct).

name: Lukasmarkt Mayen
desc: The Eifel's biggest fair and one of Germany's oldest, now in its 622nd year: nine days of rides, beer tents, stalls and a horse market below Mayen's Genovevaburg.
basis: City of Mayen tender for the 622nd Lukasmarkt: 16–24 Oct 2027

name: Nuits de Champagne
desc: Troyes' week-long French song festival, famous for its massive choir of hundreds of singers paying tribute to a star artist.
basis: Annual October song festival (17–24 Oct 2026)

name: Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE)
desc: The world's biggest club-music event: five days and nights of hundreds of venues, from huge raves to intimate club nights, plus a daytime industry conference.
basis: festivalinfo.nl and DJ Mag report 20–24 October 2027; official site has pre-registration only

name: Dutch Design Week
desc: Northern Europe's largest design event spreads graduate shows, studio openings and installations across Eindhoven, especially the converted Philips factories of Strijp-S.
basis: Visit Brabant event page: 23 October 2027 until 31 October 2027

name: Fête des Vins de Chablis
desc: About fifty Chablis winemakers pour free tastings in the village streets, while the wine brotherhood parades and blesses the new vintage.
basis: Fourth weekend of October each year (24–25 Oct 2026, 78th edition)

name: Salon du Chocolat
desc: The world's biggest chocolate show at Paris Porte de Versailles: chocolatiers and pastry chefs, tastings, live demos and the chocolate fashion show.
basis: Official Salon du Chocolat site

name: Foire Internationale et Gastronomique de Dijon
desc: France's major food fair in Burgundy's capital: regional producers, wine and a different guest country or region each year to eat your way through.
basis: Runs around All Saints to Armistice Day (31 Oct–11 Nov 2026, 96th edition)

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon
desc: A fast, flat autumn marathon that starts and ends in the 1928 Olympic Stadium and loops along the Amstel and through Vondelpark; shorter races on Saturday.
basis: Official site: Edition 2027: Saturday 30 and Sunday 31 October

name: FILMZ Mainz
desc: Mainz's festival of German-language cinema: new features, documentaries and shorts from Germany, Austria and Switzerland, often with filmmakers present.
basis: Two weeks Mon–Sun in early November (Nov 2–15 2026)

name: IFFMH Film Festival
desc: One of Germany's oldest film festivals, focused on arthouse and auteur cinema from new international directors, screening in Mannheim and Heidelberg.
basis: 11 days from a Thursday in early November (Nov 6–16 2025, Nov 5–15 2026)

name: Hochheimer Markt
desc: A fair held since 1484 below Hochheim's vineyards: hundreds of market stalls, rides, Riesling and Federweißer stands, ending with fireworks on Tuesday night.
basis: Fri–Tue in early November, ending the second Tuesday (6–10 Nov 2026)

name: Jazzdor Strasbourg
desc: Strasbourg's contemporary jazz festival: adventurous European and international artists in venues across the city and the Rhine region.
basis: Opens the first Friday of November and runs ~10 days (Nov 6–15 2026)

name: Museum Nacht Amsterdam
desc: One ticket, one night: dozens of Amsterdam museums stay open until the early hours with DJs, performances, workshops and food. Tickets sell out.
basis: First Saturday of November

name: Armistice Day in Ypres
desc: Ypres' moving WWI remembrance day: a special Last Post ceremony at the Menin Gate, a poppy parade through the town and services at St George's Memorial Church.
basis: Held every 11 November at the Menin Gate and in the town centre

name: Le Guess Who?
desc: Adventurous music festival with artist-curated programmes across Utrecht's venues and churches, centred on TivoliVredenburg; experimental, global and folk sounds you won't hear elsewhere.
basis: Official site: 11-14 November 2027

name: Mainzer Fastnacht – Season Opening 11.11.
desc: At 11:11 on 11 November, thousands in jester caps pack Schillerplatz as the fools' rights are read out and Mainz's carnival season officially begins.
basis: Every year on 11 November at 11:11 the new carnival season is proclaimed on Schillerplatz

name: GLOW Eindhoven
desc: Eindhoven's free light-art festival: a walking route of outdoor installations and projections through the city each evening for a week.
basis: Eight evenings Sat–Sat starting the Saturday between Nov 7–13 (Nov 8–15 2025, Nov 7–14 2026)

name: Sinterklaas Arrival in Amsterdam
desc: Sinterklaas sails into Amsterdam by steamboat and rides his white horse through the centre to Dam Square, cheered on by hundreds of thousands of families.
basis: Usually the first suitable Sunday after 11 November (2026: Sun 15 Nov; 2021, same weekday pattern: 14 Nov)

name: Beaujolais Nouveau
desc: The new Beaujolais vintage is released at midnight on the third Thursday of November, with cellar tastings, torch processions and village parties.
basis: Release date fixed by French decree: 3rd Thursday of November

name: Vente des Vins des Hospices de Beaune (Trois Glorieuses)
desc: Burgundy's most famous wine weekend: the historic charity auction in the Halles, plus street parties, open cellars and tastings across Beaune.
basis: Charity auction held the third Sunday of November (15 Nov 2026); 2027 date not yet published

name: Amsterdam Light Festival
desc: Light artworks along Amsterdam's canals and streets through the darkest weeks of winter. Free to walk the route, or see it from a canal boat.
basis: Thursday in late November to mid-January Sunday (Nov 26 2026–Jan 17 2027)

name: chocolART Chocolate Festival
desc: Germany's biggest chocolate festival takes over Tübingen's half-timbered old town: chocolatiers from across Europe, tastings, workshops, chocolate sculpture and sweet street food for six days.
basis: Tue–Sun in early December (1–6 Dec 2026)

name: Fête des Lumières Lyon
desc: Lyon glows for four nights around 8 December: light shows on historic façades and along the rivers, and candles in residents' windows. Free.
basis: Four nights always including Dec 8; when Dec 8 fell midweek (2021) it ran Dec 8–11

name: Habits de Lumière
desc: Épernay's Avenue de Champagne lights up with video mapping on the great Champagne houses, street shows, music, fireworks and plenty of bubbly by the glass.
basis: Held each year on a mid-December weekend (11–13 Dec 2026)

name: Pfalz Village Wine Festivals
desc: Almost every Pfalz wine village throws its own Weinfest or Kerwe between spring and late autumn. Check the online calendar for this weekend's picks.
basis: Recurring season of village Weinfeste and Kerwe every year
